content: Evidence discipline: right after any read that shows a needed value, upsert it (value + unit + period, citing that span) before doing anything else. Never repeat an identical search; if a search already pointed you to a document, read further offsets in it instead. For derived answers (growth %, ratio, difference), first list every input (e.g. current AND prior period from the same table) in unresolved, upsert each one, then compute from the evidence ids and finalize. Leave at least 3 turns for upsert, compute and final.
